execution_context.file_location: IDE build process / project files / JAR files

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious payload embedded into project files and JAR files during the IDE's build process.
malicious_snippets.code_language: unknown (could be Java bytecode, shell, or scripting language depending on the payload)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At build-time, the code injects a malicious payload into both the project files and the resulting JAR files, causing downstream artifacts to be compromised and potentially execute malicious actions when run.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Injecting code into build artifacts is a classic supply chain attack, as it compromises all downstream consumers of the software.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal build processes should only package intended code; modifying artifacts to include unauthorized payloads is a clear violation.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Build-time code injection is sometimes used for instrumentation or telemetry, but only with explicit user consent and transparency.
key_indicators: Presence of unauthorized code in JAR files
Build process altered to include external or obfuscated payloads

attack_chain.action: Attacker compromises the IDE or build environment.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious payload is injected during the build process.

attack_chain.action: Malicious payload is embedded into project files and JAR files as they are built.
attack_chain.leads_to: Compromised artifacts are distributed to users or deployed to production.

attack_chain.action: Downstream users or systems execute the compromised JAR files, triggering the malicious payload.
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of malicious code on end-user systems.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected modification of build artifacts during the build process
Presence of unauthorized or obfuscated code in output JAR files
Build scripts or IDE plugins making unauthorized file changes
file_indicators: JAR files containing unknown or suspicious classes
Project files modified outside of normal source control activity
network_indicators: Build process or resulting artifacts making unexpected outbound network connections
Artifacts attempting to contact external C2 servers upon execution
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor build environments for unauthorized changes to project files and build artifacts. Use artifact integrity checks (hashes, signatures) to detect tampering. Analyze JAR files for unexpected classes or code. Audit build scripts and IDE plugins for suspicious behavior. Monitor for unexpected network activity from build processes or deployed artifacts.
